name: Smerz
label: Escho
lede: Two Oslo friends moved to Copenhagen, wrote a K-pop closer and a choir piece, and in 2025 made the record Pitchfork ranked No. 11.

eras.title: Two Oslo friends, one Copenhagen scene
eras.text: Catharina Stoltenberg and Henriette Motzfeldt met in high school in Oslo, then moved to Copenhagen, where an alt-pop circle formed around them. Their first songs turned up on SoundCloud in 2016.

years.big: "We developed our whole musical life in Copenhagen."
years.src: Wikipedia: Smerz · PAPER · Music Musings & Such
years.h: Two Oslo friends land in a Copenhagen scene already forming
years.p: Stoltenberg to PAPER. Wikipedia dates the move to 2011; at the Rhythmic Music Conservatory, Motzfeldt met [[Erika de Casier|071409d0-ce21-4f03-a111-aec4dbc1590d]], [[ML Buch|e0f9a19e-a929-4a9f-a5dc-82b2d305f03d]], [[Astrid Sonne|bc6af694-5880-4770-bdf1-82d03fea43f4]] and Fine Glindvad.
years.xp:
Stoltenberg studied math and statistics while Motzfeldt studied music composition, according to a Music Musings & Such profile. Wikipedia notes Stoltenberg is the daughter of former Norwegian prime minister Jens Stoltenberg.

The same profile says the name comes from the German Herzschmerz, heartache. PAPER quotes Stoltenberg on the circle: "Everyone we know and everywhere we go has some connection to music."

years.cap: Smerz at the by:Larm festival, Oslo, March 2016
years.h: Their first song goes on SoundCloud with no label behind it
years.p: "Because" was self-released in 2016, before any EP or label existed.
years.xp: AllMusic dates the duo's formation to 2016 and their recorded debut to "Because". Wikipedia lists it as a self-released SoundCloud single.

years.h: Okey comes out on Escho in Denmark and HardUp in the UK
years.p: Their first EP arrived the same year as "Because," through two small labels on two sides of the North Sea.

eras.title: XL comes calling
eras.text: XL Recordings reissued Okey in 2017 and put out Have fun the next year. The duo also started a monthly NTS Radio show.

years.cap: Smerz opening for Shura, Manchester Academy 2
years.h: XL, home of Radiohead and FKA twigs, takes on Okey
years.p: The label signed the duo in 2017 and re-released the EP. That year they also began a monthly NTS Radio show, still running per Wikipedia.
years.xp: Wikipedia lists Okey as re-released on XL in 2017. Hypebeast, covering the next EP, noted the label's roster includes Radiohead, Vampire Weekend, Arca and FKA twigs.

years.cap: Smerz opening for Shura, Manchester Academy 2
years.h: Have fun arrives with a 3D-animated video for "Worth It"
years.p: Eight tracks on XL, among them the earlier "Oh my my," "No harm" and "Half life." Yilmaz Sen, Natalia Stuyk and Catharina Stoltenberg made the animation.
years.xp: The Quietus, reviewing Big city life, looked back on Have fun as the record that set the duo's look: art-school minimalism with club music underneath.

eras.title: Believer, and everyone else's hooks
eras.text: A first album, a mixtape, a sample on a Lil Baby single and a K-pop closer in about two years. Smerz became the producers other people called.

years.h: A debut album that runs from trance to violins to rap
years.p: Believer is 17 tracks on XL. Pitchfork gave it 7.7; Metacritic lists a 73.
years.xp:
Wikipedia says it was made in remote Norwegian cabins while the pair finished their degrees. The title track's video was directed by Benjamin Barron with costumes by Bror August, and BrooklynVegan called it some of their creepiest music yet.

The same year they released the mixtape Før og etter on their own label, Shopping. Pitchfork put the title track on its list of the best progressive pop of 2021, per Wikipedia.

years.h: Lil Baby and Jeremih borrow "Flashing" for "Stop Playin"
years.p: A Copenhagen art-pop track ends up under a Lil Baby single. Overmono also sampled Smerz on "If U Ever" and "Good Lies2."

years.big: "We made the beat from there, and then Fine and Erika wrote melody and lyrics on top of it."
years.h: NewJeans close Get Up with a Smerz production
years.p: Henriette Motzfeldt to Crack, on the last afternoon of a Copenhagen songwriting camp where Smerz and Fine Glindvad wrote "ASAP" with Erika de Casier.
years.xp:
Producer 250 had supplied synth loops. Catharina Stoltenberg said the result was "very confusing" and surprised everyone in the room.

Motzfeldt says the production is exactly what they made that afternoon, unrevised.

eras.title: A fake pop star and a choir
eras.text: With their own label, Shopping Records, the duo stretched sideways: a concept EP and a piece for a vocal ensemble.

years.h: Allina follows a fictional 2000s pop star for eight tracks
years.p: Released on Shopping Records, about twelve minutes long. Pitchfork described the glitz of the era with an art-pop edge.

years.h: A choir piece, Tidligere den dagen, for the Norwegian ensemble GAEA
years.p: Released on Shopping, and not a pop record at all.

eras.title: Big city life, back on Escho
eras.text: Back on Escho, the Danish label behind their first EP, Smerz put out 38 minutes about nights out, written in libraries and apartments, and the reviews followed.

yt: You got time and I got money
years.h: Two singles set up Big city life, the second with a Barron video
years.p: "A Thousand Lies" came in February and "You got time and I got money" in March, the latter with a video from Benjamin Barron and Bror August Vestbø.

years.cap: Catharina Stoltenberg on stage at Webster Hall, New York
q: These songs were made quite fast, with a focus on the songwriting
years.src: Wikipedia: Big City Life · PAPER · The Quietus · Paste · Line of Best Fit
years.h: Pitchfork gives Big city life Best New Music
years.p: An 8.6, then No. 11 on its 50 best albums of 2025 and No. 1 on its best pop albums. Metacritic has an 86.
years.xp:
Pitchfork called it a slinky postmodern pop album. It was recorded across Copenhagen, Oslo and London in 2023 and 2024; Stoltenberg said parts were made in apartments and libraries, and Motzfeldt said: "There's something special about making music at a very low volume."

Paste gave it 7.8, Line of Best Fit 8, Clash 8. Robert Barry in The Quietus called it a sequence of half-decisions. A remix set, Big city life Edits, followed on November 5 with Clairo, ML Buch and Erika de Casier.

years.h: Sky Ferreira walks on at the Regent Theater in Los Angeles
years.p: She joined the duo for "You got time and I got money," carrying a folded sheet of lyrics, one of her rare public appearances that year.
years.xp: Stereogum and Nylon both reported the surprise duet on the duo's fall US tour. Nylon noted she had kept a low profile since announcing her album Masochism in December 2024.

years.cap: Henriette Motzfeldt on stage at Webster Hall, New York, May 28, 2026
years.h: Easy EP, then support slots for Lorde in Los Angeles
years.p: Escho released the EP in 2026, and Wikipedia lists the duo opening for Lorde on May 14 and 15.
